turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: Good morning. Can I help you?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Good morning. I booked a seat on the eight thirty coach to Hillford, but my name isn't on the list at the gate.

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: Let me check. What's the name on the booking?

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Sam. I booked it online two days ago.

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: I've found it, but it's for tomorrow, not today.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Oh no! I think I chose the wrong date. I really need to travel today. I have a meeting in Hillford at one.

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: That's okay. There are still seats on the eight thirty today. I can change your booking, but there's a five-dollar fee.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: How long is the journey? Will I arrive before one?

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: Yes. It takes about three hours, so you'll arrive at about eleven thirty.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Great. Then please change it. Can I pay by card?

turns.speaker: Partner
turns.text: Of course. That's five dollars, please. Thank you. Today's eight thirty coach, seat twelve. Please go to gate three.

turns.speaker: Learner
turns.text: Today at eight thirty, seat twelve, gate three. Thank you so much!
